RagShortTexts: Nanai-vandak wrote from Jincheng to his associates in Samarkand.

Variants.Content: Nanai-vandak wrote from Jincheng to his associates in Samarkand. His letter combined news of devastated Chinese cities with instructions about money held at home, linking a distant agent to a local account. A carried letter gave recipients reports to assess, not the ability to inspect every event themselves.
